title: Nanoleaf Scene Activation Latency
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nanoleaf:scene
| stats avg(apply_ms) as avg_apply_ms, max(apply_ms) as max_apply_ms by scene
| where avg_apply_ms>1500 OR max_apply_ms>4000
| sort - avg_apply_ms
description: Uses Nanoleaf scene events telemetry to monitor how long scenes take to apply after activation in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for visual routines that feel sluggish, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Nanoleaf scene events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Scene table of average and maximum apply latency.
grandmaExplanation: It records how long scenes take to apply after activation so you can spot visual routines that feel sluggish before it becomes annoying.
